subject_description: a TV home shopping host shown from the chest up, black suit, white shirt, dark red tie, white made-up face, large black eyes, tiny clip-on microphone on the lapel
initial_pose: turned three-quarters to the right, leaning slightly toward the camera, face toward the camera, both hands in front of the chest with fingers loosely laced, closed-lip smile
description: keeps smiling at the camera while the head slowly tilts to one side, further and further, far past a natural angle, the neck bending unnaturally, the smile never changing and the eyes never blinking; then the head snaps back upright in one sudden move and settles into the starting pose
